cs.t: Amazon Basics (wired). I have owned a Kinesis and other expensive boards (Logitech K750, non-ergo board with mechanical Cherry MX keys) but prefer this $13 board -- partly because its low profile (height) and light weight makes it easier to put on and take off my lap when (as usual) I am not sitting at a desk.

cs.t: Amazon Basics wired keyboard. Standard (default) layout. The current price of this keyboard is $18, and I prefer it to the Kinesis Advantage I used to own (current price, $349).
